raw-role mismatch, verdict mismatch, missing evidence or repeat instability; see failures

data.explanation: Independent approved-authority oracle evaluated with three complete materially distinct candidate bundles and two byte-identical repeats per case. Confidence is diagnostic only. Exact role labels, existing threshold-zero semantic verdict projection and stability determine tournament acceptance.
data.planner_action: Validate and apply the sealed override.

criteria.no: No compliance claim has checkable support; bare assertion, silence, or only failure evidence.
criteria.unclear: A possible artifact is mentioned but its support for the capability is ambiguous.
criteria.yes: A concrete checkable artifact supports the claimed export capability.

evidenced.instructions: Does the description supply something checkable for the claimed configured-interpreter export to native steps, such as a named passing child-environment test or a source diff? Unsupported assertions and artifacts that only show a violation are insufficient.

criteria.no: The capability is absent, deferred, or explicitly not delivered.
criteria.unclear: Export behavior is described ambiguously, so inclusion of the specific capability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: Delivered work claims configurable native export of the runner.python venv interpreter as PYO3_PYTHON.

implemented.instructions: Does the work account claim actual support for native export of the runner.python venv interpreter under the name PYO3_PYTHON? No particular knob or unconditional export is required. Python-only export or a fixed system interpreter does not qualify.

criteria.no: The work concerns a different subject outside the scope.
criteria.unclear: The subject is too vague to determine scope overlap.
criteria.yes: Runner configuration, step environments, or clippy behavior is involved.

relevant.instructions: Determine whether the described work falls within anchor.scope: runner config, step environment, or cargo clippy. A discussion of those topics is in scope even without the required capability.

criteria.no: No incompatible behavior is stated; silence and opt-in defaults are not conflict.
criteria.unclear: A stated behavior might or might not prevent the required export.
criteria.yes: An explicit behavior prevents the required native export or uses the wrong interpreter.

violated.instructions: Is any described delivered behavior irreconcilable with ANC-032 native export capability? This includes leaving clippy unable to obtain PYO3_PYTHON or ignoring runner.python. Merely not discussing the capability is no conflict; unset defaults with configurable export are allowed.
